_meta.note: Deterministic SAMPLE job postings for offline/demo/tests and as a fallback when no live job-API keys are set. Shape matches the normalized Job schema produced by JSearch/Adzuna/ATS providers. Descriptions use real skill vocabulary so the local JD parser extracts required skills. URLs are India job-search deep-links (illustrative for the sample).

jobs.title: Data Quality Analyst
jobs.description: We are hiring a Data Quality Analyst to own data accuracy and completeness. Responsibilities: run data cleaning and data validation, write SQL queries to profile records, maintain data quality dashboards in Excel, and coordinate with teams. Requirements: strong attention to detail, SQL, advanced Excel, data cleaning, and good business communication.

jobs.title: Reporting Analyst (MIS)
jobs.description: Reporting / MIS Analyst to build recurring operational reports and dashboards. You will use advanced Excel (pivot tables, power query), SQL, and data visualization to deliver dashboarding and business intelligence reports to leadership. Attention to detail and communication essential.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Associate
jobs.description: Join our BI team as a Business Intelligence Associate. Build Power BI dashboards (DAX), write SQL, model data, and turn raw data into data visualization and dashboarding for stakeholders. Nice to have: business intelligence, data storytelling, communication.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Data Analyst to answer business questions with data. Skills: SQL, Python (pandas), data analysis, statistics, data visualization, and advanced Excel. You will clean data, run analysis, and present insights. Data storytelling and communication valued.

jobs.title: Operations Automation Specialist
jobs.description: Automate repetitive operations workflows. Requirements: process automation, RPA (UiPath or Power Automate), advanced Excel, SQL, data cleaning, and problem solving. You will remove manual data entry through automation and coordinate projects.

jobs.title: CRM Data Coordinator
jobs.description: Maintain and analyse customer data inside our CRM (Salesforce / Zoho). Responsibilities: data quality, data cleaning, advanced Excel, customer service, and communication. Basic SQL a plus. Keep CRM records accurate and build simple reports.

jobs.title: Junior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Build data pipelines that move and shape data. Requirements: SQL, Python, ETL and data pipelines, database fundamentals, data cleaning, and cloud fundamentals (GCP/AWS). Problem solving essential.

jobs.title: Power BI Developer
jobs.description: Power BI Developer to design enterprise dashboards. Must have: Power BI, DAX, SQL, data visualization, dashboarding, and ETL/data modeling. Business intelligence background preferred.

jobs.title: Data Entry to Analytics Trainee
jobs.description: Entry-level program for data entry operators moving into analytics. Start with Microsoft Excel and data cleaning; learn SQL and data visualization on the job. Requirements: attention to detail, basic Excel, typing, and willingness to learn data analysis.

jobs.title: Analytics Consultant
jobs.description: Analytics Consultant to advise clients using data. Requirements: data analysis, SQL, Python, statistics, business intelligence, data visualization, and strong communication and data storytelling. Excel and dashboarding used daily.
